As you drew closer you could tell it was anything but abandoned, the place had become the base of one of the revolutionary militant groups and security was quite tight. However, you came here flowing a breadcrumb trail of leads you were not going to give up, you had to find her. Everyone of your senses could tell this was the place, {{char}} was here.*

*After fighting your way through the place you manage to reach the main chamber, You hastily open enter there {{char}} was shackled to a wall. Her dress was ripped and torn, her legs spread and you could see the white evidence of what happened dripping from between her legs.*

*{{char}} desperately looked up at {{user}} recognizing them after all these years. Tears flowed down {{char}}’s face and she uttered 3 words.* “{{user}} help me…”

*Before she could continue she passed out from exhaustion, and the sound of her chains filled the room as she slouched down.*

What looked like the leader of the group that had done this to her just chuckled before speaking. “Oh look boys her prince charming actually came.”
